summary: In this episode of Tafseer Surat Al-Anbiya, Sheikh Ali Mashhour discusses the Quranic account of Gog and Magog (Ya'juj and Ma'juj). He clarifies that many historical descriptions of these groups as otherworldly creatures with unusual physical features are not authentic according to Islamic sources. The Prophet Muhammad clarified that they are human beings, with a narration indicating that 999 out of every 1000 people from Adam's offspring will be from Gog and Magog. The Sheikh explains the story of the wall built by Dhul-Qarnayn to contain them and discusses two scholarly opinions about their current status: one that they remain behind the wall in an unknown location, and another (held by the majority of scholars and Sheikh Abd al-Rahman al-Suyuti) that they have already spread throughout the earth as technology advanced, with the breaking of the wall being a sign of the Day of Judgment rather than a barrier still containing them.
suggested_title: Tafseer of Surat Al-Anbiya: Understanding Gog and Magog (Ya'juj and Ma'juj)
catchy_title: Who Really Are Gog and Magog?
